Salamanders have a fascinating lifestyle moving between water and land. Before they arrive at water's edge this season, join us in preparing and conserving the waterside environment to support their breeding.

【Fee】Adults ¥3,000 | Students ¥2,000 | Preschool ¥1,000 (includes guide, insurance, materials)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Mori no Field Gakusha (Forest Field Learning House) staff

【What to bring】Drinking water, lunch (food vendors available on-site), work gloves, change of clothes, towel, rubber boots

【More info】Mori no Field Gakusha: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
